investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Quilloxa Care (clinic and patient management SaaS); Platform: AWS ap-southeast-1 (zones ap-southeast-1a/ap-southeast-1b/ap-southeast-1c); network range 10.186.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster quillo-prod-apsout (EKS); Egress: two Linux NAT gateways (natgw-01, natgw-02) in active/active ECMP carry all outbound traffic to external APIs; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
